reviews.title: Leaderboard manipulation issues.
reviews.text:
On the Fanfiction leaderboard, you can see new authors receiving hundreds or even thousands of Power Stones. However, when you look at the accounts sending those Power Stones, all of them were created on the same day and supporting the same novel lass then day old. 

While one or two newly created accounts might be normal, seeing hundreds of accounts created on the same day sending Power Stones to the same author is highly suspicious. This activity is especially noticeable on the monthly leaderboard.

They are vote manipulation by using fake accounts to artificially boost rankings. Make this stop it has been happening since years now.

reviews.title: Best of Mediocre Options
reviews.text:
This has lately been my favorite fanfiction app. My biggest complaint up until now has been that there’s no real insight into how long a story is other than how many chapters there are, which is a relatively meaningless statistic given how short some chapters are. 

But the interface just seems to be getting worse, the latest update forces through massive margins which makes reading a pain and the home screen layout where you can now see a lot fewer book cover pages at once. Finally, the audiobook feature went from being ahead of all the other competition to get clunkier and clunkier to the point now that it’s so unreliable it’s not even worth using - the frustration just gets too high.

Compared to the rate at which fanfiction.net has been degrading this is doing much better, and you can tell that there are people actively working on it.

Other than fixing these issues, one other thing that I think would be a huge improvement is for there to be a ranking based on lifetime power stones I like I get that the idea is that resetting the power stone scores keeps it fresh, but I think that that doesn’t disservice to some of the older hidden gems on the website. 

Please fix the app so I can update this review!

reviews.title: Leaderboard manipulation issues.
reviews.text:
On the Fanfiction leaderboard, you can see new authors receiving hundreds or even thousands of Power Stones. However, when you look at the accounts sending those Power Stones, all of them were created on the same day and appear to be supporting the same fanfiction.

While one or two newly created accounts might be normal, seeing hundreds of accounts created on the same day sending Power Stones to the same author is highly suspicious. This activity is especially noticeable on the monthly leaderboard.

This raises concerns about potential vote manipulation or the use of fake accounts to artificially boost rankings. Such activity is unfair to genuine authors who put time and effort into writing quality fanfiction, only to be overshadowed by accounts that may be manipulating the leaderboard. Every time the Power Stones reset, the top 30 positions on the leaderboard seem to be dominated by authors who may be benefiting from this suspicious activity.

I believe this issue deserves further investigation. Please look into this suspicious Power Stone activity and consider implementing measures to prevent abuse of the system. Taking action would help ensure a fairer leaderboard, improve the user experience, and give genuine authors a better chance to have their work recognized before they become discouraged and leave the platform.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

reviews.text:
Previous times audio was down it took 3-4 days and within 48 hrs it went down again. Even with their update.

The app is great for amateur writers to develop but it has many flaws. The AI lacks the ability to provide intonation and if it don’t know how to read a word it will spell it which impacts the flow of the story telling. There are a lot more technical issues but for free stories I try to ignore them. However the biggest issue is their preference for making money. Their FP offers are misleading until you open it to read the fine print. Not all FP are site wide. Some are designated for a specific book or category which I wasted my time watching ads to earn cause I will never use them. Also, their method for designating how many coins you must spend to open a chapter varies and it appears it depends on how many coins you buy or have left. The more you have, the higher the cost to unlock a chapter. I noticed this after buying coins only to see the cost to open the chapter double or triple. Also, as you buy coins the offers for getting a free site wide FP reduces. In the long run, you’re better off not buying any coins or watching any ads without confirming if it’s something you will actually use.

Lately the app has been logging me out often and I have never had a problem logging in and continuing to read. This last time, however, all my progress is lost. Books I haven’t touched in over a year and had removed from my library are back. Books I had unlocked over half the book on are gone and chapters are locked again. My VIP status lost 4 levels and all my coins are gone. Uses the chat function in the app only to have the app lock that feature on me. I have emailed support and received no answers. Hundreds of dollars spent and I can’t get any of my progress back just like that.  I’ll crying as I will be canceling my coin pack renewal and removing the app permanently because I was so far into the stories and wanted to finish them. No way I’m paying all over again to unlock.

Follow up: after stating that I had already contacted support about this issue with no revolution in 7 days, the developer is recommending I contact support. The customer service is a total joke in that there is a serious lack of it.

reviews.title: Avoid this app. Wildly expensive and deeply misleading.
reviews.text:
Do not buy this app. In my experience, it is an incredibly expensive pay-to-read platform with poor customer service.

What starts as a £7.99 subscription quickly turns into endless additional purchases. Expect to spend £200 or more if you want to finish a single novel. The pricing is completely unclear—you never know how many coins you’ll need because the cost to unlock chapters varies, and the number of chapters in a book even appears to increase over time.

The business model is designed to get you emotionally invested in a story before forcing you to pay extortionate amounts just to reach the ending. I spent hours watching adverts and earning points and Fast Passes, only to discover they couldn’t even be used to unlock the book I was reading. It felt like a complete waste of time.

The hidden costs are what make this so frustrating. If I’d known from the beginning that reading one novel would cost many times more than buying a normal book—or even several books—I would never have started.

To make matters worse, I later discovered that some of these novels are available to read for free on other websites.

I contacted customer support to raise concerns about the pricing and lack of transparency, but they were unhelpful and unwilling to resolve the issue.

Overall, this feels like a predatory monetisation model that relies on keeping readers hooked rather than being transparent about the true cost.

Please avoid this app and save your money.
